chunks: The Mosque of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, during his time, was by the minaret that was in the middle of the mosque, and beyond it toward the qiblah about thirty cubits, and to its right, to its left, and behind it approximately the same.

key_terms.الْمَنَارَةِ: the marked structure used here as a point of spatial reference
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ: mosque; the sacred prayer space being described
key_terms.وَسَطِ: middle or center of the mosque

ai.seo_question: What were the dimensions of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during his lifetime?
ai.summary: This report describes the dimensions and layout of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during his time. It preserves a historical detail about the mosque’s extent in relation to the central minaret and the qiblah direction.
